text: The reviewer replaces hand-written one-shot observer promises with TestUtils.topicObserved because the resolved directory is unused, and replaces generic popup-event waits with BrowserTestUtils.waitForPopupEvent. The assigned test uses those helpers, awaits confirmation and application before checking persisted fields, and has a separate defaults task. The reviewer additionally asks for the root folder and folder-with-children case; the author acknowledges the missing case and the landing checks parent plus both children. A request to split still more tasks is optional discussion; the single-folder task still contains the child scenario. The async production suggestion is also applied: await the descendant helper and then await showSuccessMessage rather than attach an unnecessary .then inside an async function. Existing lessons already cover the helper catching failures and the historical grouped bit/assertion mismatch; these waits do not prove every write succeeded. A proposed macOS repair and Try link are reports, with no opened passing job. Partial historical evidence: Bug comments9/10/12/35 unavailable; no new runtime validation.
title: Appearance review replaces unused observer plumbing and checks explicit folder scopes
